scope: offline preparation; candidates are not started automatically
required_before_each_attempt: Recheck exactly one enuma, boot complete, root, slot, unlock and original partition digests
Confirm operator available for recovery and collect current image/FD/source hashes
Continue only after the preceding attempt has returned and Android/root/digests are verified
stop_conditions: No observable return: stop all additional candidates and recover using the established path
Identity, backup, source or digest mismatch: do not boot
A return time alone does not prove driver or GOP success
